no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee input was sought on this application. Although Kerydin is a New Molecular Entity, the application presented no novel or complex regulatory issues that required the input of an advisory committee.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for KERYDIN (tavaborole) NDA204427. The review team determined early in the review cycle that, although tavaborole is a New Molecular Entity, the application presented no novel or complex regulatory issues and raised no significant safety or efficacy questions requiring outside expertise. Consistent statements appear in the Office Director memo, the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, the Medical Review, and the approval letter, so there were no AdComm-driven changes to the approval.
